strategy.overview: Spell B-A-D C-A-T-S by completing the five Bird drops and three Milk Bottle drops. When the full name is lit, shoot the center Fishbowl ramp to collect the progressive Jackpot; there is no Multiball. The Doghouse wheel and Fish Bone-Us give useful scoring alongside the repeatable ramp routes.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the five Bird drops and three Milk Bottle drops; each bank completion advances B-A-D C-A-T-S. After all seven letters are lit, shoot the center Fishbowl ramp for the Jackpot. For the Doghouse wheel, spell S-E-A-F-O-O-D and shoot the lit Doghouse before its timer ends; Bad Cats has no Multiball.
strategy.summary: Complete both drop banks repeatedly to spell B-A-D C-A-T-S, then shoot the center Fishbowl ramp for the progressive Jackpot. Spell S-E-A-F-O-O-D and shoot the lit Doghouse for its wheel. There is no Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Advance BAD CATS
quickInfo.summary: Complete either the five Bird drops or the three Milk Bottle drops.

quickInfo.name: Collect Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Spell B-A-D C-A-T-S, then shoot the center Fishbowl ramp.

quickInfo.name: Spin the wheel
quickInfo.summary: Spell S-E-A-F-O-O-D and shoot the lit Doghouse before time expires.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Bad Cats does not have a Multiball mode.

steps.text: Complete the five Bird drop targets or the three Milk Bottle drop targets to light the next B-A-D C-A-T-S letter.
Repeat either bank until all seven letters are lit.
Shoot the center Fishbowl ramp to collect the progressive Jackpot.
Start the cycle again; the Jackpot must be relit from the first letter after each collect.

alternatives.title: Spin the Doghouse wheel
alternatives.when: Use this after S-E-A-F-O-O-D is complete.

steps.text: Spell S-E-A-F-O-O-D through its playfield lanes and targets.
Shoot the lit Doghouse before its timer expires to spin the award wheel.

alternatives.title: Collect Fish Bone-Us
alternatives.when: Use this when the Fish target and Trash Can return are controllable.

steps.text: Hit the Fish target to light the timed Fish Bone-Us at the Trash Can.
Roll through the lit right inlane to add a ten-times multiplier, then shoot the Trash Can to collect.
Repeat the Fishbowl ramp to advance its fixed awards through 30,000, 50,000, 100,000, and Extra Ball.
Repeat the Tiger ramp without breaking the sequence to build 50,000, 100,000, 200,000, and one million.
Choose the ramp whose return is safer instead of forcing a drop-bank completion from a bad feed.

machineSetup: Confirm how Extra Ball, Special, and the progressive Jackpot are configured before competitive play.
Test both drop banks, Fishbowl and Tiger ramps, Doghouse, wheel, Fish target, Trash Can, S-E-A-F-O-O-D switches, and ramp returns.

cautions.issue: The Jackpot resets to an unlit state after collection.
cautions.response: Expect to spell BAD CATS again; do not return immediately to the Fishbowl ramp unless its repeat award is the goal.
